name: Hold Person
summary: A Humanoid makes a Wis save or is Paralyzed; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.
text: Choose a Humanoid you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Paralyzed condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success. You can target one more Humanoid for each spell slot level above 2.
